description: An APPLICATION project: one web app and its OAuth application client (apiVersion thoryn.io/application/v1). It declares no environment, no user and no workspace configuration (that is the workspace's CONFIG project); the account its e2e signs in with is an ephemeral sandbox test identity CI mints per run (thoryn env test-identity create) and revokes afterwards. Nothing in the repository is rendered: the pipeline reads its wiring from the GitHub Actions variables below at run time. This file stays in the repository as the declaration of what the creation flow must set up.

THORYN_ISSUER.description: Platform base issuer the thoryn CLI signs in to, e.g. https://auth.stg.thoryn.org. Not the application's issuer: that one is resolved at run time (.thoryn/app-env.mjs).

THORYN_WORKSPACE.description: Slug of the Thoryn workspace the application belongs to.

THORYN_ENVIRONMENT.description: Slug of the SANDBOX environment the application's client lives in, where its per-run test identity is minted, and that the workload identity trust is bound to.

THORYN_WIF_CLIENT_ID.description: clientId (wi_...) of the workload identity trust created for this repository in that sandbox.

sandbox.description: Who CI is: the workload identity trust in the sandbox. It provisions the app's client, mints one ephemeral test identity per run (tenant:test-identities.write, revoked at the end of the run) and reads the sandbox's test inbox. It holds no tenant:users.* scope: an application never defines a user of the tenant.
